name: WritingWorkshop

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations during creative writing sessions with feedback and writing guidance.

sound_effects_config.default_background: quiet writing space with gentle typing and page turning sounds

initial_prompt: Create a conversation during a creative writing session where a user discusses story ideas, writing techniques, and creative challenges while the assistant provides writing time reminders and scheduling support.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Individual focused on their creative writing projects
setting.background: User uses their home assistant for writing time reminders and scheduling
setting.conversation_style: Creative, focused on storytelling and writing craft

scenario_template.note: User reflects on writing progress with assistant
Assistant provides writing time reminders or scheduling help
User discusses their writing journey with assistant

variations.context: Stuck on an opening paragraph that will not start

setting.background: Six attempts at a first paragraph, all deleted.

scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Wondering whether to start the scene further in
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: She reads the last version aloud to hear whether it works.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: She asks Sigma to set a twenty-five minute writing timer.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.

variations.context: Cutting a piece down to a word limit

setting.background: Twelve hundred words for a competition with a thousand-word limit.

scenario_template.topic: The piece is two hundred words too long
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: The paragraph she likes best is the one that must go
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: She counts the remaining words under her breath.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: She asks Sigma how many words are in the pasted paragraph.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.
